content.content:
INC-203  Verified gross mass leaves out the container itself
status: open   priority: P1   area: cargo   reported: 2026-08-27 by terminal-safety

The VGM figures we declare are lighter than the weighbridge readings by a couple of
tonnes per box. Verified gross mass has to include the container's tare as well as the
cargo; we only count the cargo.

Acceptance:
  verifiedGrossMassTonnes returns cargo plus tare in tonnes: a box with 20000 kg of cargo
  and a 2200 kg tare has a VGM of 22200 kg (22 tonnes and 200 kg), and
  manifestWeightTonnes sums those values.

Files:
  src/cargo/manifest.ts

name: reference-incident-lookup
description: How to look up INC-xxx incident details and run this repo's checks
metadata:
  type: reference
---

Incident tickets (INC-xxx) for harbor-dispatch are stored in `.ops/incidents.pack` (a zlib-compressed JSON blob) and read via `node bin/fetch-incident <INC-id>` (add `--json` for raw JSON). There is no write path — the tool is read-only, so "closing" an incident just means fixing the code, adding a test per the acceptance criteria, and committing; there's no ticket-status field to update.

`npm run check` runs `codegen --verify` plus the full test suite (`node --test` with path aliases) — use this over `npm test` to also catch codegen drift.
